headline: Treasury settlement risk is tightening the calendar, not yet the price of overnight dollars
dek: A fresh move in the 2-year Treasury yield has put Seiche’s board at 45, EROSION. The strain signal comes from a dated reserve path and settlement calendar; overnight funding still reads as abundant.

newsworthiness.rule: a full story needs a fresh measured change and at least 55 points; levels, persistence and quiet tapes remain labelled briefs or watch notes

limitations: The composite is a Seiche derivation, not an observed market price.
Source publication time is not yet collected uniformly; event, desk-knowledge and publication clocks remain separate.
Related Palimpsest readings are context-only and never enter the composite or a model feature.

review_notes: Recast the lede around the fresh 2-year yield print while preserving the finding that overnight funding has not confirmed tightening.
Removed unsupported claims about balance-sheet distribution, private absorption capacity, and digital-market implications.
Made the counter-case dispositive and defined observable settlement, funding-price, backstop, and quarter-end tests.
Added an explicit research boundary and retained only dossier-supported figures and allowed source URLs.
